name: pump_surf_scene
summary: Godot 4.6.3 Node3D scene that consumes the WaveFrame JSON emitted by core/lib/pump_visualizer_3d.py (sibling agent F) and renders each Ripple as a 3D sphere positioned at its normalized (x, y, z) hex-grid coordinate. Bot ripples render red, human ripples green, and surf_target ripples gold with an emissive pulse plus a torus halo marker placed in a dedicated SurfTargetAnchors container. A CanvasLayer HUD reports surf_state (top-center, large), bot_density_avg (top-left red ProgressBar), and human_inflow_score (top-right green ProgressBar). When surf_state == 'abort', a full-screen red ColorRect overlays the viewport at 25% opacity. Pairs with the dapp_server `/dapp/api/pump_wave` route (provided by sibling agent H) and the freetier_gate token storage.
engine_pattern: Two-node shell: PumpWaveFetcher owns the polling Timer + HTTPRequest pair and forwards each parsed JSON body via the wave_received signal; PumpSurfController is a per-scene Node3D that subscribes to that signal and rebuilds the WaveField + SurfTargetAnchors children every frame. Ripple meshes are imperatively constructed (SphereMesh + StandardMaterial3D per ripple). Previous ripples queue_free before the next batch spawns, so memory stays bounded. No per-frame physics; everything happens in response to one wave_received signal every 2 seconds.

scene_tree.PumpSurf/Camera3D: Camera3D — orbit position +12,+8,+12 looking toward origin, fov 60
scene_tree.PumpSurf/WorldEnvironment: WorldEnvironment — deep cyberpunk sky (purple/black) + glow bloom
scene_tree.PumpSurf/DirectionalLight3D: DirectionalLight3D — cool key light, shadows enabled
scene_tree.PumpSurf/WaveField: Node3D — empty container; controller spawns Ripple sphere meshes
scene_tree.PumpSurf/SurfTargetAnchors: Node3D — gold pulse torus markers for surf_target ripples
scene_tree.PumpSurf/HUD/BotDensityBar: ProgressBar — top-left red, 0-100, driven by wave.bot_density_avg*100
scene_tree.PumpSurf/HUD/BotDensityLabel: Label — caption 'bot density' under the bar
scene_tree.PumpSurf/HUD/HumanInflowBar: ProgressBar — top-right green, 0-100, driven by wave.human_inflow_score*100
scene_tree.PumpSurf/HUD/HumanInflowLabel: Label — caption 'human inflow' under the bar
scene_tree.PumpSurf/HUD/AbortOverlay: ColorRect — full-screen; only colored (red 25%) when surf_state == 'abort'

coordinate_mapping.rationale: WaveFrame ripples carry normalized [0..1] hex-grid coords. The controller projects them into a wide, shallow 3D box so the camera at (+12,+8,+12) frames the whole field.
coordinate_mapping.surf_target_extras: TorusMesh halo at the same origin, scale 0.4, gold emissive (energy 4.0)

ripple_schema_v1.is_surf_target: bool — when true: emissive sphere + torus halo + gold tint

wave_schema_v1.auth: Authorization: Bearer <freetier_token>  (falls back to no_signal empty wave when missing)
wave_schema_v1.response_schema: { surf_state: String, bot_density_avg: float, human_inflow_score: float, ripples: [<ripple>...] }
wave_schema_v1.status: NOT YET IMPLEMENTED — sibling agent H owns the `/dapp/api/pump_wave` route. Until then, the fetcher polls but the HTTP code != 200 fallback emits a no_signal empty wave and the HUD reports 0/0 with no ripples.
wave_schema_v1.owner_to_add_route: dapp_server (route handler shipped by sibling agent H)

token_sources.native_export: user://freetier_token.txt — written by the freetier flow when the bearer is bound to a host

runtime_requirements.autoload_required: false — both scripts attach inside the scene; no project.godot edit
runtime_requirements.http_dependency: localhost:8520 must serve /dapp/api/pump_wave; offline boot uses the no_signal empty-wave fallback so the scene still renders

guarantees: Boots without backend — missing token or non-200 response short-circuits to a no_signal empty WaveFrame and the HUD shows 0/0
Zero project.godot mutation — both scripts are pure scene-attached nodes; no autoload, no input map, no new layer
Idempotent rebuild — _clear_ripples queue_frees every prior WaveField + SurfTargetAnchors child before _spawn_ripple runs
Bounded memory — ripple count == server-side ripple count; nothing accumulates across frames
All scripts cwd-scoped to res://src/ and res://scenes/ — no absolute paths
surf_state='abort' is visually unmistakable — full-viewport red ColorRect at 25% opacity
blockers_phase_2: dapp_server: add GET /dapp/api/pump_wave route that streams pump_visualizer_3d.py output as JSON (owned by sibling agent H)

Camera orbit controls: drag-to-rotate + scroll-to-zoom — currently a fixed isometric vantage
Per-ripple animation: smooth radius/position lerp between frames instead of hard rebuild (would require keying ripples by stable id)
Surf-target audio cue: trigger a chime when a new surf_target appears (subscribe to a derived 'new_target' signal)
Bot/human legend: small HUD legend explaining the color code
Tunable poll interval: expose start_polling argument via an exported var so the editor can adjust without code edits
usage_example:
# From main_controller or any scene:
get_tree().change_scene_to_file("res://scenes/pump_surf.tscn")
# Or load + instantiate inline:
var packed = load("res://scenes/pump_surf.tscn")
add_child(packed.instantiate())
